value.title: From scattered freelance records to a working project-operations system
value.question: How could fragmented freelance records become evidence I could actually use for planning and pricing?
value.proof: Built a working operational tool and used real project data to improve how future work is estimated. Across three projects, it surfaced approximately 18% of work that had been underestimated.
value.claimBoundary: AI assisted construction; AI is not claimed as a core runtime capability. The ~18% figure is an estimation-gap signal, not productivity, revenue or profitability impact.

value.title: From isolated design knowledge to a recurring team learning loop
value.question: Could recurring design sessions make UX evidence part of the wider product team’s working knowledge?
value.proof: Engineering Manager feedback documents that the team engaged with the shared insights.
value.claimBoundary: Qualitative feedback only; no measured efficiency, cohesion or organisational-performance improvement is claimed.

value.title: From individual usability testing to a group-research format
value.question: Could usability-testing structure be adapted to capture group behavior without losing individual observations?
value.proof: Created a reusable template for group-testing sessions.
value.claimBoundary: Team-building is secondary context; no performance effect is claimed.

value.title: From design methodology to a hands-on learning experiment
value.question: How could design methodology become understandable through practice instead of presentation alone?
value.proof: Participant feedback provides qualitative evidence that the compressed hands-on format was useful and engaging.
value.claimBoundary: No personality-performance causality or measured brand-awareness improvement is claimed.

value.title: From scattered ideas to a connected capture-and-filter system
value.question: How could idea generation become a continuous system instead of a disconnected set of activities?
value.proof: RSA Student Design Awards — Final 7 Shortlist
value.claimBoundary: Recognition is preserved exactly; no efficiency or engagement improvement is claimed.

value.title: From open-ended brainstorming to a structured creative workflow
value.question: Could a creativity tool support both generating possibilities and converging on useful directions?
value.proof: Developed a complete physical–digital creative-tool concept around one coherent design-thinking workflow.
value.claimBoundary: No measured creativity or productivity improvement is claimed.

value.title: From cultural storytelling to a participatory Rukai experience
value.question: How could cultural knowledge become something people actively experience rather than passively observe?
value.proof: Red Dot Award — Game Design Winner. Existing governed recognition confirms the work and attribution.
value.claimBoundary: No tourism, economic-growth, quality-of-life or talent-return causality is claimed.
